title: Microsoft Teams: Catch up on conversations in Microsoft Teams mobile
description: Catch up in Teams mobile provides a unified view of all directed and followed conversations across chats, meeting chats, channels and threads. The mobile-optimized card view supports swipe actions, helping you quickly review and triage lists of important items.
